name: Indiana Wesleyan University
academic_ranking: Private evangelical Christian university affiliated with The Wesleyan Church; largest private university in Indiana and largest CCCU member. Total enrollment ~15,000 (about 2,000 traditional residential undergraduates on the Marion campus, ~12,000 adult/online learners, ~700 seminary graduate students). Offers 80+ undergraduate degrees and 87 majors. Ranked 13th in the Midwest by U.S. News & World Report (2022). Endowment ~$309.9 million (2025). (Source: Wikipedia / indwes.edu, checked 2026-07.)
financial_aid: IWU invests over $25,000,000 annually in institutional aid based on merit, need, and other factors. Average financial aid package to campus students is $21,249. Aid types include scholarships, grants, work-study, and federal/state (Indiana) loans and grants. Updated academic scholarships arriving fall 2026. (Source: indwes.edu/admissions/tuition-aid, checked 2026-07.)
facilities_notes: Softball home field name not published on the softball program pages checked (iwuwildcats.com, 2026-07). Team is part of IWU Wildcats athletics on the Marion, IN campus.
program_reputation: Nationally competitive NAIA program competing in the Crossroads League. Ranked #4 nationally as displayed on the program pages (2025-26). (Source: iwuwildcats.com softball pages, checked 2026-07.)
